title: Race and Ethnic Standards for Federal Statistics and Administrative Reporting
detail: One mark only. A person of mixed origins was to be reported in the category which most closely reflects the individuals recognition in his community.

title: Revisions to the Standards for the Classification of Federal Data on Race and Ethnicity
detail: Respondents shall be offered the option of selecting one or more racial designations. Asian or Pacific Islander split into two categories.

title: Revisions to OMBs Statistical Policy Directive No. 15: Standards for Maintaining, Collecting, and Presenting Federal Data on Race and Ethnicity
detail: Middle Eastern or North African added as a minimum category, separate from White. Effective 2024-03-28; agency action plans due 2027-03-28 after two extensions; full compliance 2029-09-28.
